title: The End of the Proverb About Distant Times
description: The Lord's word comes to Ezekiel concerning two proverbs in Israel: that the days pass without visions being fulfilled, and that prophecies concern distant times. God declares that He is putting an end to these proverbs—the days are near, every vision will be fulfilled, false visions will cease, and His word will no longer be delayed but completed in the days of the rebellious generation.
